 Honourable Mr. Justice Robin Phukan

Date : 17.11.2023

Heard Mr. A. S. Tapadar, learned counsel for the applicant and also heard Ms. N.
Page No.# 2/4 Das, learned Addl.P.P. for the State respondent.
This application, under Section 438 Cr.P.C. is preferred by the applicants, namely, 1. Alphee Ahmed @ Alphee Fahmeed Rahman and 2. Farhad Towfiq Rahman, who have been apprehending arrest in Page No.# 1/4 vs The State Of Assam on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186164172/
1 connection with Bhangagarh P.S.Case No. 301/2023 u/s 420/294/354/323/506/34 IPC, for grant of pre-arrest bail.
It is to be noted that the above noted case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged by one Manish Agarwal on 9.11.2023.
The essence of allegation made in the FIR, dated 9.1.2023, is that Alphee Ahmed has availed a loan amounting Rs. 2,34,996/- from IDFC Bank on 27.9.2022.
Thereafter, she has failed to make payment of a single EMI to the bank.

Thereafter, on 9.11.2023, at about 4 PM, the informant and his colleague Smti. Payel Deb, Senior Manager and staff went to the office of accused person for collecting the installment/settlement of the loan amount and then the accused person started abusing them and accused No. 2 abused his colleague with ill intention and forced her into a room and touched various part of her body and assaulted them, but somehow they managed to escape.

Mr. Tapadar, learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants are innocent and they are no way involved with the offence alleged in the FIR and in connection with the same incident,
the applicant No.2 also lodged one FIR with the Bhangagarh P.S. on 9.11.2023 and that they are ready to cooperate with the investigating agency and therefore, it is contended to allow the petition.
On the other hand, Ms. Das, learned Addl. P.P. submits that case diary may be called for.

Having heard the submission of learned Advocates of both sides, and also considering the nature of accusation, perusal of the case diary is found to be necessary, and accordingly, Ms. Das, learned Addl. P.P. shall produce the case diary before this Court on 8.12.2023.

In the interim, considering the submission of learned Counsel for both sides and also considering the attending facts and circumstances on the record, this court is inclined to extend interim protection to the applicants, till receipt of the case diary.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the applicants, 1. Alphee Ahmed @ Alphee Fahmeed Rahman and 2. Farhad Towfiq Rahman, in connection with Bhangagarh P. S. Case No. 301/2023 u/s 420/ 294/ 354 /323/ 506 /34 IPC, they shall be released on interim pre arrest bail, on their executing a bond of Rs.50,000/-each,
with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
The above privilege is, however, subject to the following conditions:
1. That the applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer as and when required;
2. That the applicants shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and Page No.# 4/4 Page No.# 1/4 vs The State Of Assam on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186164172/
2
3. That the applicants shall not leave the jurisdiction of the learned CJM, Kamrup without prior permission.
